retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome double exposure merging a frontal gaze with a profile view, integrated with wispy smoke and raw handwritten script.
excludeWhen: single-subject sharp focus is the priority

recipe.visualDefinition: A black and white composition featuring a central male subject rendered through a double exposure technique. One face looks directly forward with a somber expression, while a secondary, lighter exposure shows the same face in profile with eyes closed. Wisps of white smoke or vapor swirl from the left, blending into the subject's hair and the dark background. The overall mood is introspective and dreamlike.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark frontal face acts as the anchor for the lighter profile overlay.
The white smoke on the left balances the negative space of the dark background.
Handwritten text in the upper corners frames the central dual-portrait.
coreInvariants: Double exposure of the same subject
Presence of atmospheric smoke or vapor
High contrast between deep blacks and bright highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The dual-portrait is centrally located, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The direct, dark-eyed gaze of the frontal face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the frontal eyes, moves right to the closed-eye profile, then follows the smoke wisps back to the left-side text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the left side provides a canvas for the primary title text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for smoke and text highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and hair detail
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast creates a dramatic, moody atmosphere.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights mimicking a felt-tip marker
Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated ascenders and descenders
Angled baseline for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' in the title has a long, sweeping horizontal bar
Lowercase 'g' and 'y' have deep, looping tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pairing a large, expressive title script with a smaller, more compact signature-style script in the opposite corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, personal feel of the original lettering.
Matches the stroke width and informal connectivity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome double exposure portrait of a man, merging a dark frontal view with a light profile view. Add wispy white smoke emerging from the left side against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, white marker-style script in the top left and top right corners, ensuring the text has a natural, slightly irregular cursive flow.

verificationChecks: Is the double exposure clearly visible?
Is the contrast between the black background and white smoke sharp?
Does the text look hand-written rather than digitally typed?

adjustableVariables: Transparency level of the profile overlay
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the smoke doesn't obscure the eyes of the frontal face.
Verify the script is legible despite its informal style.
Check that the double exposure doesn't look like a simple side-by-side crop.
Confirm the black levels are deep and consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] in a [Monochrome Double Exposure] with [Atmospheric Element like Smoke] and [Hand-drawn Script] for an introspective [Mood].
